```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)

# Read entropy file
ruta <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/Entropia_alineamiento_58.xlsx"
entropia <- read_excel(ruta)

# Convert decimal commas to dots if necessary
entropia$Entropy <- as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", entropia$Entropy))
entropia <- entropia[!is.na(entropia$Entropy), ]  # Remove NA values

# Manual classification ensuring that Entropy == 0 is Conserved
entropia$Group <- NA
entropia$Group[entropia$Entropy == 0] <- "Conserved"
entropia$Group[entropia$Entropy >= 0.1 & entropia$Entropy <= 0.5] <- "Medium"
entropia$Group[entropia$Entropy > 0.5] <- "High"

# Create subsets by group
conserved <- subset(entropia, Group == "Conserved")
medium <- subset(entropia, Group == "Medium")
high <- subset(entropia, Group == "High")

# Export separate files
write_xlsx(conserved, "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/conserved_entropy_58.xlsx")
write_xlsx(medium, "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/medium_entropy_58.xlsx")
write_xlsx(high, "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/high_entropy_58.xlsx")

png("C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/hist_entropy_hp58.png",
    width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)

hist(entropia$Entropy,
     breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
     main = "General entropy distribution by position HPV 58",
     xlab = "Shannon Entropy",
     col = "lightblue",
     xlim = c(0, 1),
     xaxt = "n",
     freq = TRUE)
axis(side = 1, at = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1))

dev.off()  # <- IMPORTANT

# Entropy profile
ggplot(entropia, aes(x = Position, y = Entropy)) +
  geom_line(color = "coral", size = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(entropia$Position), by = 500)) +
  labs(title = "Entropy profile by position in HPV58",
       x = "Position",
       y = "Shannon Entropy") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 58),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Force order in the Group factor
entropia$Group <- factor(entropia$Group, levels = c("Conserved", "Medium", "High"))

# Create count table with range labels
group_count <- entropia %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  count(Group) %>%
  mutate(
    Range = case_when(
      Group == "Conserved" ~ "Entropy = 0",
      Group == "Medium"    ~ "Entropy 0.1 - 0.5",
      Group == "High"      ~ "Entropy > 0.5"
    ),
    Label = paste0(Group, "\n(", Range, ")")
  )

# Force order again in Label to maintain order in the plot
group_count$Label <- factor(group_count$Label, levels = group_count$Label)

# Bar plot with customized X labels and range displayed
ggplot(group_count, aes(x = Label, y = n, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +  # Smaller number displayed above
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Conserved" = "#66c2a5",
                               "Medium" = "#fc8d62",
                               "High" = "#8da0cb")) +
  labs(title = "Classification of positions based on entropy",
       x = NULL,
       y = "Number of positions") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),  # Smaller X-axis text
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Read Excel file
ruta <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/conserved_entropy_58.xlsx"
conservados <- read_excel(ruta)

# 2. Sort by position (just in case)
conservados <- conservados %>% arrange(Position)

# 3. Detect continuous regions
conservados <- conservados %>%
  mutate(diff = c(NA, diff(Position)),
         grupo = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(diff) | diff != 1, 1, 0)))

# 4. Get start and end of each continuous region
regiones_conservadas <- conservados %>%
  group_by(grupo) %>%
  summarise(start = min(Position), end = max(Position), .groups = "drop")

# 5. Plot conserved regions as blocks
ggplot() +
  geom_rect(data = regiones_conservadas,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
            fill = "forestgreen", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(regiones_conservadas$end), by = 150)) +
  labs(title = "Conserved genomic regions in HPV58",
       x = "Genome Position",
       y = "Conservation (Shannon Entropy = 0)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.right = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)

#The gene ranges were used based on each genotype
# 1. Read file
ruta <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/high_entropy_58.xlsx"
datos <- read_excel(ruta)

# 2. Create an empty Gen column
datos <- datos %>%
  mutate(Gen = NA_character_)

# 3. Assign gene name based on Position
datos <- datos %>%
  mutate(Gen = case_when(
    Position >= 110  & Position <= 559  ~ "E6",
    Position >= 574  & Position <= 870  ~ "E7",
    Position >= 883  & Position <= 2817 ~ "E1",
    Position >= 2753 & Position <= 3829 ~ "E2",
    Position >= 3892 & Position <= 4122 ~ "E5α",
    Position >= 4244 & Position <= 5662 ~ "L2",
    Position >= 5643 & Position <= 7139 ~ "L1",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Outside defined ranges
  ))

# Convert Gen to character and remove rows without an assigned gene
datos$Gen <- as.character(datos$Gen)
datos_filtrados <- datos %>% filter(!is.na(Gen) & Gen != "")

# 4. Optional: save the result to a new Excel file
write_xlsx(datos, "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/High_entropy_58_con_genes.xlsx")
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# 1) Leer y limpiar
path  <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/Entropy_position_genes.xlsx"
data  <- read_excel(path)

data <- data %>%
  # Opcional: recortar nombres de columnas (elimina espacios al inicio/final). Quita esto si no es necesario.
  rename_with(trimws) %>% 
  mutate(
    Entropy = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(Entropy), fixed = TRUE)),
    Gen     = as.character(Gen)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gen), Gen != "", !is.na(Entropy))

# 2) Orden fijo de genes (ajusta si tu anotación cambia)
genome_order <- c("E6","E7","E1","E2","E5α","L2","L1")
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Gen = factor(Gen, levels = intersect(genome_order, unique(Gen))))

# (Alternativa) Ordenar genes por entropía mediana (descomenta para usar)
# gene_order_median <- data %>% group_by(Gen) %>%
#   summarise(med = median(Entropy), .groups = "drop") %>%
#   arrange(desc(med)) %>% pull(Gen)
# data <- data %>% mutate(Gen = factor(Gen, levels = gene_order_median))

# 3) Etiquetas del eje X incluyendo tamaño muestral (n) por gen
n_lab <- data %>%
  count(Gen, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Gen, "\n(n=", n, ")"))

data <- data %>%
  left_join(n_lab, by = "Gen") %>%
  mutate(Gen_lab = factor(label, levels = n_lab$label))

# 4) Violín + boxplot + marcador de media
p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Gen_lab, y = Entropy)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4, fill = "white") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.2, fill = "grey90") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribución de Entropía de Shannon por Gen (HPV58)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Entropía de Shannon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p)

# (Opcional) Guardar figura en alta resolución
ggsave("C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/Fig_violin_entropy_by_gene.png",
       plot = p, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Read data
ruta <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/Entropy_position_genes.xlsx"
datos <- read_excel(ruta)

# Check structure
str(datos)

# If Gen has NA or empty values for unassigned positions, you can filter

datos$Gen[is.na(datos$Gen)] <- ""     # Use empty string instead of NA

# Base plot with entropy line
p <- ggplot(datos, aes(x = Position, y = Entropy)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray70") +              # Base entropy line
  geom_point(data = datos %>% filter(Gen != ""),
             aes(color = Gen),               # Points colored by gene
             size = 2) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +     # Color palette for genes
  labs(title = "Entropy profile by Position with Gene annotation",
       x = "Position",
       y = "Entropy",
       color = "Gene") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# Add gene labels for positions that have a gene assigned
p + geom_text(data = datos %>% filter(Gen != ""),
              aes(label = Gen),
              vjust = -1,
              size = 3,
              check_overlap = TRUE)  # Avoid overlapping text
```

```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# Read FASTA file
aln <- readDNAStringSet("C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/HPV 58/HPV_58_ALI_filtrado.fasta")

# Use the first sequence as reference
ref <- as.character(aln[[1]])
ref_name <- names(aln)[1]

# Function to extract the country code from IDs containing IARCxxxxxXX
extract_country <- function(id) {
  match <- str_match(id, "IARC\\d+([A-Z]{1,2})")[,2]
  return(match)
}

# Create table
datos <- tibble(
  ID = names(aln),
  Country = extract_country(names(aln)),
  Sequence = as.character(aln)
) %>%
  mutate(
    Mutations = map_int(Sequence, ~ sum(strsplit(.x, "")[[1]] != strsplit(ref, "")[[1]])),
    Length = nchar(ref),
    Identity = round((1 - Mutations / Length) * 100, 2)
  )

# Summary by country
summary_tbl <- datos %>%
  filter(!is.na(Country)) %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_identity = mean(Identity),
    SD_identity = sd(Identity),
    Min_identity = min(Identity),
    Max_identity = max(Identity)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_identity))

print(summary_tbl)

# Plot
ggplot(datos %>% filter(!is.na(Country)), aes(x = reorder(Country, -Identity), y = Identity)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +
  labs(title = "Genetic conservation by country (HPV 58)",
       x = "Country",
       y = "Percent identity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

```
